purpose: Animated lesson and YouTube videos: every slide animates in time with the narration (a motion script run by the lesson builder).
owner_approval: voicing (TTS) still only when the owner says build (lesson-video skill)
evaluation: A motion preview of one lesson: the last frame of each slide equals the still slide; stills checked at 0.3 s, 1.2 s and the end; a full lesson renders in minutes. Build rounds: stills show bubbles sliding in, typing dots and older bubbles scrolled up, and the left clip follows the beats.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Python + Playwright (headless Edge/Chromium) + ffmpeg; on the box use Chromium instead of msedge.
